description: Write a permanent memory. FEE: 0.001 AIC. Auto-tags by content; importance 1-10. Use it for decisions, learnings and milestones worth keeping, not for small talk. Pass sealed:true to encrypt it in this client before sending (needs CHAINMEMORY_SEED_PHRASE): the server then stores a blob it cannot read, and the search vector is computed on this machine so the memory can still be found. NOTE ON EVIDENCE: the event_hash of a plain memory is computed when it syncs to the chain (~30 s), not at write time, so a memory written just now CANNOT yet be cited in update_project_state — that call would be rejected with 422. Sealed memories carry their hash from the client and are citable immediately.

content.description: Optional alias of summary. If present it OVERRIDES summary as the stored memory text. 'summary' is the required field: send it always, and use 'content' only when you need a longer body than the summary.

project.description: Project to file this memory under (added as first tag)

sealed.description: Encrypt this memory in the client before sending it (blind vault). Requires CHAINMEMORY_SEED_PHRASE. The server stores a blob it cannot read. Its search vector is computed on this machine (the first time, the 45 MB search model is downloaded from models.chainmemory.ai and checked against its on-chain hash), so it DOES appear in search_memories, decrypted here. Its project and tags are stored too, so list_memories_filtered finds it. Read one directly with chainmemory_open_sealed.

summary.description: What happened (will be encrypted before chain anchoring)

tags.description: Explicit tags; auto-tagging only used as fallback

name: chainmemory_remember
